entry: Recognition by country per swissuniversities 'Country-specific admission requirements'; HSG applies its own admission regulations on top.
ib: IB recognised as equivalent subject to HSG recognition rules (published at erlasse.unisg.ch, lex II_B_09 — JavaScript-only page, detail not machine-verifiable on 13 September 2026). No grade cutoff is applied at selection: 'We will consider only the results you achieve during the selection procedure.' Submit predicted grades with the application.
alevel: A-levels recognised ('essentially equivalent to the Swiss maturity certificate (such as a German Abitur or British A-level)'); detailed rules at erlasse.unisg.ch lex II_B_07 (JavaScript-only, not machine-verifiable). Only selection-procedure results count for admission; submit predicted grades.
cbse: Indian Std XII (CBSE) alone NOT sufficient. swissuniversities table valid for AY2026/27, entry India / St. Gallen: 'University degree (at least 3 years) + HSG selection procedure'.
isc: Indian Std XII (ISC) alone NOT sufficient — same swissuniversities AY2026/27 rule for India: 'University degree (at least 3 years) + HSG selection procedure'.
other: Places for foreign applicants limited by law; admission only via HSG selection procedure and 'We will consider only the results you achieve during the selection procedure' — school grades are not the ranking criterion.
english: No English certificate required: 'You do not need to submit proof of language proficiency when you apply.' Recommended level at start of study at least C1 CEFR. Free Oxford English Placement Test offered for the English track. NOTE: applicants whose certificate requires the Complementary Examination ECUS need German B2 regardless of track — ECUS exams are conducted in German only.
selection: HSG selection procedure (foreign applicants only): online aptitude test + video interview; two dates per year, calendar week 7 or calendar week 23; taken in the language chosen for the Assessment Year. Swiss/Liechtenstein citizens and Swiss C-permit holders are exempt.
deadline: 1 October - 30 April (annual window for the autumn-semester start; programme starts autumn semester only)
feeEU: HSG differentiates Swiss vs foreign nationals, not EU/non-EU. Foreign nationals (incl. EU): Bachelor CHF 3,129/semester (currently applicable); CHF 3,343.50/semester starting autumn semester 2026 (per costs page). Swiss nationals: CHF 1,229 rising to CHF 1,310.50/semester.
feeNonEU: Foreign nationals: Bachelor CHF 3,129/semester (currently applicable rate); CHF 3,343.50/semester starting autumn semester 2026. About CHF 6,258-6,687/year.
scholarships: HSG Best Talents programme; Advice Center for Study Funding for scholarships/loans (FAQ: 'The Advice Center for Study Funding provides information about your funding options'). No automatic entry scholarships published.
visa: Not verified on unisg.ch (13 September 2026). Non-EU/EEA nationals generally need a Swiss national D visa via the Swiss representation after admission — confirm with the St. Gallen migration office.
apply: Online via the HSG online application tool (unisg.ch), Compass mailbox for decisions
notes: Fully-English path: choose the English track of the Assessment Year (Economics specialisation), then the BWL major (factsheet: programme languages German and English). Degree = B.A. HSG. Indian Std XII holders are NOT admissible without a completed 3-year university degree plus the HSG selection procedure. StartWeek mandatory in calendar week 37, semester starts week 38.
corrected_value_if_any: Sheet said deadline 'February 28' — actual application period is 1 October - 30 April. Sheet said tuition 'CHF 1,456/year' — actual foreign-national rate is CHF 3,129/semester (CHF 3,343.50 from autumn 2026), roughly CHF 6,258+/year. Sheet said 'German proficiency essential / main language is German' — the Assessment Year in Economic Sciences can now be taken entirely in English. Sheet's IB/A-level notes ('IB Diploma accepted; subject to HSG selection procedure') are broadly right but no grade cutoffs exist — only selection-procedure results count.
exact_quote: The Assessment Year in Economic Sciences (BWL, VWL, IA, Law and Economics) can be taken either entirely in English or entirely in German. The Assessment Year in Law and the Assessment Year in Computer Science can only be completed in German.
documents_required: Digital passport photo; signed Enrolment Agreement; passport/ID; CV (HSG template); foreign upper secondary school-leaving certificate (upload later if pending); certificates from last three school years; predicted grades for IB/A-levels/APs; certified German or English translation if documents not in German, French, Italian or English
deadline_rounds: Standing annual window published on the admission page (checked 13 September 2026); for autumn 2027 entry the window is 1 October 2026 - 30 April 2027. BWL factsheet states '1 February to 30 April' — admission page (1 October - 30 April) taken as authoritative; contradiction noted.
fee_year: Costs page read 13 September 2026: 'Currently applicable tuition fees' vs 'Tuition fees starting in autumn semester 2026'
india_entry: Indian Std XII (CBSE) alone NOT sufficient. swissuniversities table valid for AY2026/27, entry India / St. Gallen: 'University degree (at least 3 years) + HSG selection procedure'.
